title: Materialize Strata as an optional provider reference and tiered MoE execution donor
decision: FA3-PROVIDER-STRATA-001 is an optional disabled-by-default provider candidate, never an authority.
Applications must reach Strata only through FA3-AUTH-MODEL-ROUTER-001 and its governed data plane.
All accelerator, CPU, NUMA memory and storage placement remains owned by FA3-AUTH-HOST-RESOURCE-BROKER-001 and existing storage governance.
The reusable architectural result is FA3-TIERED-MOE-EXECUTION-CONTRACTS-001, which is provider and vendor neutral.
No original Strata source code may be copied while the pinned upstream snapshot lacks an explicit verified reuse license.
The clean-room FA3 placement planner may implement the documented concepts independently.
Runtime/current-host promotion remains pending physical execution evidence and immutable provider/runtime identity.
